sketches.mechanism: Goroutine leak — a goroutine that sends on a channel no one will ever receive from blocks forever, never garbage collected, never terminated
sketches.resonance: A message meant for someone who will never listen persists silently, consuming resources in the background of a life that has moved on.

sketches.mechanism: The 'never' return type — a function typed as returning 'never' is one that can never successfully complete; TypeScript enforces that no value can inhabit this type
sketches.resonance: Some promises are structurally impossible to keep; the type system itself proves that nothing can be returned to you.

sketches.mechanism: A finalize() method that resurrects the object by re-registering a strong reference to it, preventing garbage collection — the object refuses to die but finalize is only called once
sketches.resonance: You can refuse to let go exactly once; the second time, nothing intervenes and you disappear without ceremony.
